behaviour: Add @backstage/plugin-home-react to plugins/notifications dependencies and @backstage/frontend-test-utils to devDependencies.
rules: 1. Insert "@backstage/plugin-home-react": "workspace:^", in dependencies in alphabetical order right after "@backstage/frontend-plugin-api": "workspace:^",.
2. Insert "@backstage/frontend-test-utils": "workspace:^", in devDependencies in alphabetical order right after "@backstage/dev-utils": "workspace:^",.

behaviour: Add test devDependencies to plugins/home-react/package.json so unit tests for CardExtension can run with @backstage/frontend-test-utils and @testing-library/react.
Update yarn.lock after adding package dependencies in plugins/notifications and plugins/home-react.
Use Progress from @backstage/core-components directly in CardExtension instead of calling useApp().getComponents() so card extensions render without a Backstage AppContext.
rules: 2. Remove useApp from the '@backstage/core-plugin-api' import in plugins/home-react/src/extensions.tsx.
3. Remove const app = useApp(); and const { Progress } = app.getComponents(); inside CardExtension so <Suspense fallback={<Progress />}> uses the imported Progress component directly.

sites.rule: Import InfoCard and Progress from '@backstage/core-components' and remove useApp from the '@backstage/core-plugin-api' import.
Delete the useApp() and app.getComponents() lines so CardExtension uses the imported Progress directly.

behaviour: Add translation messages for UnreadNotificationsCard to notificationsTranslationRef.
rules: 1. Add an unreadNotificationsCard section under notificationsTranslationRef messages with title: 'Unread notifications', emptyMessage: 'No records to display', viewAll: 'View all notifications', markAsRead: 'Mark as read', and errorMarkAsRead: 'Failed to mark notification as read'.

sites.rule: Insert unreadNotificationsCard translation messages after the settings object.

behaviour: Add a highlightedRow CSS class using Backstage UI CSS variables to visually distinguish a deep-linked notification row.
rules: 1. Add a .highlightedRow class after .notificationInfoRow:not(:first-child) using active BUI CSS custom properties (background-color: var(--bui-bg-neutral-2); border-radius: var(--bui-radius-2); padding: var(--bui-space-1) var(--bui-space-2);) and no deprecated BUI tokens.

sites.rule: Add .highlightedRow rule at the end of NotificationsTable.module.css.

behaviour: Accept an optional highlightedId prop on NotificationsTable and apply the highlightedRow class to the matching notification row.
rules: 1. Add optional highlightedId?: string to NotificationsTableProps.
2. Destructure highlightedId in NotificationsTable and include highlightedId in the compactColumns useMemo dependency array.
3. On the outer <Flex gap="4" align="center"> inside compactColumns.render, set className={notification.id === highlightedId ? styles.highlightedRow : undefined}.

sites.rule: Pass className={notification.id === highlightedId ? styles.highlightedRow : undefined} on the row Flex wrapper.
Add highlightedId to the compactColumns useMemo dependency array.

behaviour: Read the ?id= query parameter via useSearchParams in NotificationsPage and forward it as highlightedId to NotificationsTable.
rules: 2. Call const [searchParams] = useSearchParams(); and const highlightedId = searchParams.get('id') ?? undefined; inside NotificationsPage.
3. Pass highlightedId={highlightedId} to <NotificationsTable /> without altering existing filter defaults or triggering an extra getNotification call.

sites.rule: Read searchParams with useSearchParams() and derive highlightedId = searchParams.get('id') ?? undefined.
